title: MLK essay on mystery religions and Christianity

tellings.quote: new in fact Martin Luther King wrote a little-known essay called the influence of mystery religions on Christianity

plain: Martin Luther King Jr., the American civil rights leader, wrote a little-known essay called "The Influence of the Mystery Religions on Christianity," about the secret initiation cults of the ancient Mediterranean world and what early Christianity took from them. Jesse Michels brings it up himself during a talk about the roots of Christian stories and the Gospel of John. He raises it because, if King was right, some of Christianity's stories would be borrowed from older pagan rites.
